findings.message: Blocks are nested too deeply (5). Maximum allowed is 4. Each level of nesting is another condition the reader has to hold in their head to know whether this line runs at all. Lift a branch into a named function, return early to flatten the happy path, or invert a condition so the exceptional case exits first.
